verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's developer docs say webhooks notify your systems via HTTP POST when things change in an account. Setup is under Settings > Integrations, and payloads are signed with a SHA-256 HMAC in the x-savvycal-signature header, which covers the core of real-time notification. Missing for 10: no documented event types that explicitly name booking created, rescheduled, and canceled; no payload or retry/delivery-guarantee details; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
